subject: Recap & next steps — token economics, monthly spend corridor, and PO timing
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <claire@orchard.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@orchard.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery call — rough volumes & procurement question

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions so we can move to internal procurement: 

- Product scope: conversational assistant + search reranker for clinical docs.
- Expected steady-state (months 3–6): 250M–600M tokens / month (mix chat + long context reranks).
- Burst potential: up to ~1B tokens in peak months.
- Current target unit economics: looking for $/1M tokens in the ~$120–$220 range to make the integration viable.

Procurement question: our finance team requires a PO for any vendor spend > $50k/month. Is there a pilot structure or monthly cap that would allow us to start under that threshold while we finalize SOC2 + contracting?

Next steps from our side: finance needs an estimated month-1 vs month-3 spend table and a short list of redlines for legal. Can you provide a spend model and a short SOC2 summary we can attach to our SOW?

Thanks — looking forward to the model,
Claire
Product @ Orchard.ai

Attachment: — (will accept SOC2 summary & spend model XLSX)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <claire@orchard.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery call — rough volumes & procurement question

Claire — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate the volume ranges. Quick answers and proposed play:

- Pilot option under $50k/mo: we can run a 6-week pilot capped at $45k/month with usage throttles and a monthly spike buffer for first 2 weeks to cover ramp. That lets you validate latency and quality without triggering the PO workflow.
- Unit economics: sample tier we typically see for volumes in your band is $/1M tokens = $200 (pilot), with step-downs to ~$140–$160 for committed monthly bands > 400M tokens. We can model a short ramp with blended pricing.
- SOC2 & legal: attaching a 1-page SOC2 summary and a spend model (redwood_spend_model_v2.xlsx) with month-1/month-3 estimates at a few usage points.

Suggested next steps from Redwood:
1) We deliver a 2-tab spend model and a one-page SOC2 summary (attached).
2) Pilot kickoff: target week of Sep 27 — 6 weeks; pilot cap $45k/mo.
3) Legal: provide a starter SOW and a shortlist of likely legal redlines (we've found most customers accept Net30 + standard data terms).

Jordan / Karthik — can you review the spend model and confirm the $200 pilot rate and the recommended commit band discounts (we suggested 5% @ 400M, 20% @ 800M as placeholders)?

Thanks,
Naomi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_spend_model_v2.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf, mutual_action_plan.md

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery call — rough volumes & procurement question

Naomi / Jordan — quick notes after reviewing the model: 

- Pilot $200 / 1M tokens is fine as a short-term starter; it keeps margin while giving Orchard room to validate.
- Commit scenarios: instead of flat % discounts, propose a stepped effective price table:
  * 0–399M/mo => $200 / 1M
  * 400–699M/mo => $160 / 1M
  * 700M+ /mo => $130 / 1M (requires 6–12 month commit)
- PO threshold: clarify with Orchard whether the $50k trigger is monthly or quarterly. If monthly, the pilot cap will keep them below threshold; if quarterly, they might still need a PO if they backfill earlier months.

Ask: Naomi, when you send next to Claire please include the stepped effective price table and a one-paragraph note on typical lead times for Dedicated capacity (if they show sustained >700M/mo).

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering

From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@orchard.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Claire Zhou <claire@orchard.ai>
Cc: procurement@orchard.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery call — rough volumes & procurement question

Naomi / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the model. A few clarifications from finance/procurement: 

- Confirmation: the PO threshold is monthly spend > $50k (so pilot capped at $45k avoids a PO). Good.
- Legal ask: our legal lead wants the SOC2 summary and a short SOW to review. Please send draft SOW + proposed standard terms.
- Timing: procurement needs an estimated lead time for Dedicated capacity if we choose to commit. Ideally we want an estimate in weeks (not months) so our roadmap can plan for it. Can you provide a ballpark?

One other note on pricing: our CFO flagged $/1M tokens of ~$140 as their business case target; if you can show a path there at scale with a clear commit, it helps speed approval.

Next steps agreed: Naomi to send the stepped effective price table, a one-paragraph Dedicated lead-time estimate, and a starter SOW. Then we’ll schedule a 30-min procurement sync (procurement@orchard.ai) for early next week.

Ben
Head of Platform @ Orchard.ai
